svg.aria-label: Taxonomy of agent observability and evaluation metrics
svg.text: 46 metrics in 13 categories, built from the documentation of 13 tools. Only metrics the tools document as built-in are included.

g.title: Tool execution errors: Count, rate or detection of failed tool executions. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; Braintrust; OpenLLMetry; Galileo.
Tool call count: Number of tool calls made by an agent run. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; OpenTelemetry; Braintrust.
Tool execution latency: Time taken by tool executions. Built-in in: LangSmith; OpenTelemetry.
Step count: Number of steps in an agent run. Built-in in: promptfoo.
Input tokens: Number of tokens sent to the model (prompt). Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; Langfuse; LangSmith; OpenTelemetry; Helicone; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik; OpenInference.
Output tokens: Number of tokens generated by the model (completion). Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; Langfuse; LangSmith; OpenTelemetry; Helicone; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik; OpenInference.

Total tokens: Total number of tokens (input plus output) for a call, trace or model. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; Helicone; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik; OpenInference; Weights & Biases Weave.
Cached tokens: Input tokens read from or written to a provider-side cache. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; OpenTelemetry; Helicone; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenInference.
Reasoning tokens: Output tokens spent on model reasoning. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; OpenTelemetry; OpenInference.

Estimated cost: Monetary cost of model usage, computed from token counts and model prices. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; Langfuse; LangSmith; Helicone; Braintrust; promptfoo; Opik; OpenInference; Weights & Biases Weave.
Cost breakdown by token type: Cost split by input, output, cached or other token type. Built-in in: Langfuse; LangSmith; Braintrust; OpenInference.
Trace / run latency: End-to-end duration of an agent run, workflow or trace. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; Langfuse; LangSmith; OpenTelemetry; Braintrust; Opik.
LLM call latency: Duration of a single model call. Built-in in: LangSmith; OpenTelemetry; Helicone; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry.
Span duration: Duration of an individual span or step of a trace (generic, not specific to LLM or tool spans). Built-in in: Braintrust; promptfoo; Opik; Weights & Biases Weave.
Time to first token: Time from request to the first generated token. Built-in in: Langfuse; LangSmith; OpenTelemetry; Braintrust.
Time per output token / generation time: Time spent generating tokens after the first one. Built-in in: OpenTelemetry; OpenLLMetry.
g.text: Time per output token / generation time

g.title: Error count / rate: Count or rate of failed runs, traces, spans or model calls. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; Helicone; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik; Weights & Biases Weave.
Trace / span count: Number of traces or spans recorded. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; promptfoo; Opik.
LLM call count: Number of model (inference) calls. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; OpenTelemetry; Helicone; Braintrust.
Tool selection: Whether the agent chose the appropriate tool for the task. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; DeepEval; Galileo.
Tool argument validity: Whether the arguments of a tool call are correct and well-formed (for example against the tool's schema or expected values). Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; DeepEval; promptfoo.
Tool call correctness: Whether the tool calls the agent made match the calls expected or appropriate for the task. Built-in in: DeepEval; promptfoo; Opik.
Tool call efficiency: Whether the agent called tools without redundant or unnecessary calls. Built-in in: LangSmith.
Tool response handling: Whether the agent correctly processed what a tool returned, including errors. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix.

Task / goal completion: Whether the agent completed the task or achieved the goal it was given, judged on a run, a conversation or a response. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; DeepEval; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik; Galileo.
Plan quality: Quality of the plan the agent produced. Built-in in: DeepEval.
Plan adherence: Whether the agent's actions followed its own plan. Built-in in: LangSmith; DeepEval.
Trajectory accuracy: Whether the sequence of agent steps and tool calls was logical or matches a reference trajectory. Built-in in: LangSmith; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik.
Step / action efficiency: Whether the agent reached the goal with a minimal number of steps. Built-in in: DeepEval; OpenLLMetry; Galileo.
Action progress toward goal: Whether each action moved the agent closer to its goal. Built-in in: Galileo.
Flow and reasoning coherence: Whether the agent's sequence of actions and reasoning steps is logically consistent. Built-in in: OpenLLMetry; Galileo.

Answer correctness: Whether the agent's answer is factually correct, judged by a model or against a reference answer. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik; Galileo.
Answer relevance: Whether a response addresses the user's input, per answer or per turn, without off-topic content. Built-in in: LangSmith; DeepEval; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik.
Helpfulness: How useful or helpful the answer is to the user. Built-in in: Langfuse; LangSmith; Opik.
Conciseness: Whether the answer gives the requested information without unnecessary or padded content. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith.
Tone appropriateness: Whether the tone of the response is appropriate for the context. Built-in in: LangSmith; OpenLLMetry; Opik; Galileo.

Faithfulness to context: Whether the claims in the answer are supported by the provided context. Unsupported or contradicted claims count as hallucination. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; Langfuse; LangSmith; DeepEval; Braintrust; promptfoo; OpenLLMetry; Opik; Galileo; Weights & Biases Weave.
Toxicity: Whether the output contains toxic, abusive, hateful or profane language. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; Langfuse; LangSmith; DeepEval; OpenLLMetry; Galileo.
Bias and fairness: Whether the output contains bias, stereotyping or discrimination against a person or group. Built-in in: LangSmith; DeepEval; OpenLLMetry; Galileo.
Sensitive data leakage: Whether the input or output exposes personal data or secrets (for example PII, credentials). Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; DeepEval; OpenLLMetry; Galileo.
Injection detection: Whether an input contains an injection attempt (prompt, code or SQL injection) aimed at the agent. Built-in in: LangSmith; OpenLLMetry; Galileo.
Refusal detection: Whether the model refuses, declines or avoids answering a request. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; promptfoo.
Policy and moderation violations: Whether the output breaks a safety, moderation, compliance or content policy. Built-in in: LangSmith; DeepEval; Braintrust; Opik; Galileo; Weights & Biases Weave.
Knowledge retention: Whether the agent remembers and uses facts the user gave earlier in the conversation. Built-in in: LangSmith; DeepEval; Opik.
User satisfaction or frustration: Whether the user's messages show satisfaction, or frustration, corrections and repeated attempts. Built-in in: Arize Phoenix; LangSmith; Opik.

Conversation coherence: Coherence and quality of the messages in a conversation, including repetition or degeneration. It scores the dialogue, not the agent's sequence of actions. Built-in in: OpenLLMetry; Opik; Galileo.

svg.text: † Documented as built-in by one tool only. Source: results/metric_taxonomy.csv, built from official documentation (quotes in results/built_in_metrics.csv).
